definition.en: The round face of a clock, with the numbers 1 to 12 and 60 small marks round the edge. The hands turn on it.
definition.zh: 钟上圆圆的那一面，写着 1 到 12，边上一圈有 60 个小格。针在上面转。

definition.en: The short hand. It moves from one number to the next in an hour and goes round twice a day. At half past 4 it is halfway between 4 and 5.
definition.zh: 短的那根针。一小时走一格，一天转两圈。4 点半时，它停在 4 和 5 正中间。

definition.en: The long hand. It goes once round in an hour; each number it passes is 5 more minutes. At 3 it shows 15 minutes past, also called quarter past; at 9 people also say quarter to the next hour.
definition.zh: 长的那根针。一小时转一圈，每走过一个数就多 5 分钟。指着 3 是 15 分，也叫“一刻”；指着 9 是 45 分，也有人说“差一刻”到下一个整点。

definition.en: The thinnest hand. It goes once round in a minute; each small mark is 1 second.
definition.zh: 最细的那根针。一分钟转一圈，每一小格是 1 秒。

definition.en: A unit of time: 1 h = 60 min. One full turn of the minute hand takes an hour.
definition.zh: 时间单位：1 h = 60 min。分针转一整圈是 1 小时。课本上也写作“时”。

definition.en: A unit of time: 1 min = 60 s. There are 60 minutes in an hour, not 100.
definition.zh: 时间单位：1 min = 60 s。1 小时有 60 分钟，不是 100 分钟。课本上也写作“分”。

definition.en: A short unit of time: 60 s = 1 min. A stopwatch measures seconds, so {d:75s} is {d:1m15s}.
definition.zh: 很短的时间单位：60 s = 1 min。秒表量的是秒，{d:75s} 就是 {d:1m15s}。

definition.en: am: the times from midnight to noon. pm: the times from noon to midnight. 7 o'clock in the morning is {t:07:00}; in the evening it is {t:19:00}.
definition.zh: am：半夜 12 点到中午 12 点的时刻；pm：中午 12 点到半夜 12 点的时刻。早上 7 点是 {t:07:00}，晚上 7 点是 {t:19:00}。

term.zh: 中午 12 点、半夜 12 点

definition.en: Noon is 12 o'clock in the middle of the day; midnight is 12 o'clock at night, when a new day starts. Half an hour after noon is {t:12:30}.
definition.zh: 中午 12 点是一天的正中；半夜 12 点（也叫午夜）在夜里，新的一天从这时开始。中午 12 点过半小时是 {t:12:30}。

definition.en: How long something takes, from its start to its end. From {t:09:40} to {t:11:15} is {d:1h35m}.
definition.zh: 一件事从开始到结束用了多长时间。从 {t:09:40} 到 {t:11:15}，经过的时间是 {d:1h35m}。

definition.en: When something begins and when it ends. Starting time + duration = finishing time.
definition.zh: 一件事开始和结束的那一刻。开始时刻 + 经过的时间 = 结束时刻。

definition.en: Times counted from midnight, {t:00:00|24}, up to {t:23:59|24}, with no am or pm. After noon, add 12 to the hour: {t:15:00} is {t:15:00|24}.
A line marked with the hours like a ruler. You jump along it to find how long something takes: to the next hour, whole hours, then the minutes left.
definition.zh: 像尺一样标着钟点的线。在上面跳着数，就能求经过的时间：先跳到整点，再跳整小时，最后跳剩下的分钟。
